title: solidago camporum var. tricostata
intro: Solidago camporum var. tricostata, commonly known as a variety of the goldenrod plant, is a flowering plant in the aster family that is native to the western United States. The health benefits of Solidago camporum var. tricostata include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating wounds and soothing digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are primarily due to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Solidago camporum var. tricostata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
